data.name: Iltaf
data.gender_notes: Iltaf is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is gentle, kind, and soft in nature. This name is derived from the Arabic word 'iltif' which means 'to touch gently'. The name Iltaf carries the meaning “Gentle, kind, soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Iltaf usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who wish to be gentle and kind in their actions towards others, and to touch the hearts of those around them with love and compassion.
data.etymology: Iltaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, kind, soft.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iltaf total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: إلطف
in_arabic.meaning: الإلطف هو اسم يعني اللطف و الإحسان و الرحمة
in_arabic.long_meaning: إلطف هو اسم مشتق من الجذر اللغوي 'ل-ط-ف' الذي يعني اللطف و الإحسان. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَلَا تَقْتُلُوا النَّفْسَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ إِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ' (الإسراء: 33)، حيث يشير إلى الرحمة و الإحسان. يعتبر اسم إلطف من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة في الإسلام، مثل اللطف و الرحمة و الإحسان.

in_urdu.name: الطف
in_urdu.meaning: الطف کا مطلب ہے مہربانی، احسان، رحمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: الطف ایک عربی نام ہے جو اللغوی جڑ 'ل-ط-ف' سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مہربانی، احسان۔ قرآن کریم میں اس جڑ سے متعدد الفاظ ملتے ہیں، جن میں رحمت اور مہربانی پر زور دیا گیا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایت میں، الطف ایک مقبول نام ہے جو اچھے اخلاق اور روحانی خوبیوں کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: इलतफ
in_hindi.meaning: इलतफ का अर्थ है दयालुता, अच्छाई, और करुणा
in_hindi.long_meaning: इलतफ एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ल-त-फ' की जड़ से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ है दयालुता, अच्छाई। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम अच्छे गुणों और आध्यात्मिक विशेषताओं को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, इलतफ एक लोकप्रिय नाम है जो दयालुता और करुणा को महत्व देता है।

in_pashto.name: الطف

In Islamic tradition, Iltaf represents good qualities and spiritual attributes. The name is popular across Muslim cultures, symbolizing kindness, compassion, and mercy. It is associated with positive personality traits and is chosen for its beautiful meaning and historical significance.

It is also a reflection of the belief that humanity should strive to behave in a kind and gentle manner towards others, as exemplified by the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him).

The Quran frequently refers to God's mercy, compassion, and gentleness towards His servants. The name "Iltaf" also serves as a reminder of the gentle and compassionate nature of our most beloved Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and the immense impact he had on the lives of those around him. By bearing this name, an individual is reminded of the importance of being a gentle and compassionate presence in the world, reflecting the divine qualities of mercy, kindness, and love.
